title: Milan Bachelor Party: 3 nights of aperitivo, adrenaline & Italian nightlife
description: The ultimate bachelor send-off in Italy's style capital. Think rooftop Spritzes with Duomo views, go-kart racing, San Siro stadium tours, canal-side cocktail crawls, and dancing until dawn. Andiamo, ragazzi!

days.title: Arrive & First Night Out
days.description: Land in Milan, check in, and kick off the bachelor party with rooftop Spritzes and a Navigli canal crawl.

activities.name: Arrive at Milan Malpensa (MXP)
activities.description: Take the Malpensa Express train to Milano Centrale (~50 min, €13). Fast, easy, no taxi markup. Stylish design hotel near Centrale with a rooftop bar. Great for groups — book connecting rooms.

activities.name: Terrazza Aperol — Rooftop Kickoff
activities.description: Start the bachelor party right: Aperol Spritzes on the rooftop terrace overlooking the Duomo. Iconic. Head south to the Navigli district for a proper Italian aperitivo crawl along the canals. Hit Mag Café for craft cocktails, Rita & Cocktails for the vibe, and Botanical Club for the scene.

days.title: Stadium, Speed & Steaks
days.description: Morning at the legendary San Siro, afternoon go-kart racing, evening steakhouse feast and rooftop cocktails.

activities.name: San Siro Stadium & Museum Tour
activities.description: Walk the tunnel, visit the locker rooms, and stand pitchside at the Stadio Giuseppe Meazza — home to both AC Milan and Inter. Book the guided tour in advance.

activities.name: Go-Kart Racing at ProKart Lainate
activities.description: Outdoor karting circuit just outside Milan. Book a group race session with timing boards — perfect bachelor party bragging rights. About 25 min by taxi. Head back to the hotel. Nap. Shower. You'll need the energy for tonight.

activities.name: Rooftop Drinks at Ceresio 7
activities.description: Two rooftop pools, skyline views, and craft cocktails in a converted 1930s customs building. One of Milan's coolest terraces.

days.title: Lake Como & Grand Finale
days.description: Day trip to stunning Lake Como, then back to Milan for the grand finale bachelor dinner and legendary nightlife.

activities.name: Train to Lake Como
activities.description: Catch a morning train from Milano Centrale to Como San Giovanni (~40 min, €5). Walk the lakefront promenade and take the funicular up to Brunate for jaw-dropping panoramic views. Rent a private boat for a 1-hour cruise along the lake. Split between 5+ guys, it's surprisingly affordable. Book via Lake Como Boats or Comacina.

activities.name: Explore Como Old Town
activities.description: Wander the medieval streets, see the Como Cathedral (Gothic-Renaissance stunner), grab gelato. Chill vibes before the big night.

activities.name: Pre-Dinner Cocktails at Dry Milano
activities.description: Pizza & cocktail bar in the Brera district. Creative drinks and solid Neapolitan pizza to line the stomach. Hidden cocktail den with expert bartenders. The perfect warm-up before the finale.

days.title: Departure
days.description: Sleep in, grab one last Italian brunch, and head to the airport. Arrivederci, Milano!

activities.name: Sleep In
activities.description: You earned it. No alarms. The world's oldest shopping mall. Last-minute Italian leather goods, designer gifts, or just gawk at the architecture.

editorialSummary: The ultimate bachelor send-off in Italy's style capital. Think rooftop Spritzes with Duomo views, go-kart racing, San Siro stadium tours, canal-side cocktail crawls, and dancing until dawn. Andiamo, ragazzi!
